sections.overview: Sonorolux fluminis is a small sciaenid fish known from Sarawak, on Borneo.
sections.identification: It has a deep, rounded body and a steeply rounded snout.
sections.habitat: It inhabits estuaries and brackish water.
sections.diet: The cited species accounts do not describe its diet.
sections.behavior: No detailed activity or social behaviour is reported in the sources consulted.
sections.reproduction: The references consulted provide no species-specific breeding information.
sections.ecology: Published material is sparse: the FAO account knew only two specimens, each about 8 cm standard length.
sections.conservation: FishBase reports a global IUCN assessment of Least Concern from 2018.
